name: slider
summary: Adjusts a value along a range by dragging a small white thumb, such as the zoom level of a generation grid.
useWhen: The exact number matters less than the feel, such as zooming a grid or setting motion strength.

alternatives.name: toggle-group
alternatives.when: only a few fixed values make sense, such as 1x, 2x and 4x

alternatives.name: input
alternatives.when: people need to type an exact number, such as a seed

rules.do: Put icons or labels at the ends that say what low and high mean, such as small and large tiles.
rules.dont: Show a bare slider with no hint of what moving it does.

rules.do: Update the result while the thumb moves.
rules.dont: Wait for release before showing anything, so people guess.

a11y: Arrow keys change the value; Home and End jump to the ends.
Give it an `aria-label` such as "Grid zoom"; the value is announced as it changes.
